name: web-stride-running-app-landing-hero-hiker-on-mountain-ridge
title: Stride running app landing: a hiker with arms wide on a green ridge and a run-stats card
whatItIs: A full-bleed photo of a hiker with outstretched arms on a green mountain ridge under a blue sky, a white nav pill, 'Built for every step of your journey' in large thin white type, 'Get The App' and 'Explore More' buttons, award laurels, and a translucent card with '42,196 KM' and a route map.
whatItMeans: Uplifting and aspirational; the summit pose sells achievement more than features.
techniques: Use a triumphant pose as the hero photo.
Float a live-data card over the landscape.

vocabulary.definition: A wreath shape framing an award.
A small panel showing live figures.
